+from typing import Any
+
+from click.utils import make_str
+
+
+def prepare(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate a record and return its normalized display data."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not (key := key.strip()):
+        raise ValueError("key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must contain a value")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("enabled must be a bool")
+
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": make_str(value), "enabled": enabled}

@@ -18,3 +18,21 @@ def prepare(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
 
     value = record["value"]
     return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": make_str(value), "enabled": enabled}
+
+
+def batch(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare records in order and reject duplicate normalized keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+
+    result = []
+    seen = set()
+    for record in records:
+        prepared = prepare(record)
+        key = prepared["key"]
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {key!r}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        result.append(prepared)
+
+    return result

         result.append(prepared)
 
     return result
+
+
+def group(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    """Group enabled displays by the first character of the key."""
+    groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for record in batch(records):
+        if record["enabled"]:
+            groups.setdefault(record["key"][0], []).append(record["display"])
+    return groups

+def merge(
+    left: list[dict[str, Any]], right: list[dict[str, Any]]
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Merge validated batches, replacing left records in place by key."""
+    by_key = {record["key"]: record for record in batch(left)}
+    by_key.update((record["key"], record) for record in batch(right))
+    return list(by_key.values())
